subject: Not going to quit

body:
Our voter registration work will shape the future of our democracy. We're not going to quit until we've registered every new voter, educated potential voters, and turned out everyone we can to make sure every voice is heard in our elections.
We need your help to make it happen. RUSH $24 or more right now to fuel our voter registration work nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=091024_3&amount=24]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091024_3&amount=25]
We've been working on voter registration since we were founded in 2020, folks.
Amidst a global pandemic, we came together to advocate for mail-in ballots, register new voters, and educate everyone on how easy mail-in voting was. We succeeded beyond our wildest expectations.
So we stepped it up for 2022. Our focus was on eligible non-voters in Nevada, a key state for voter access, and helped drive tens of thousands of disengaged citizens to register to vote and participate in our elections with many key statewide races on the ballot, including Governor, Senator, Secretary of State, and Attorney General.
With our democracy and our right to vote threatened again , we have no choice but to respond and push harder. If the president can step aside for the sake of our country, the least we can do is honor that sacrifice by driving pro-democracy voters to the polls.
Our voter registration work has succeeded $3 at a time. Will you keep it going with $24 today to help register 8 more new voters? We must make 2024 our biggest voter registration campaign yet. With so many states voting under new maps, court-appointed maps, and new laws -- our voter education campaigns have never been so necessary.
California, North Carolina, and New York have changes to their voting laws this year. South Carolina has had confusion about their voting map. North Carolina, Louisiana, and New York are among the states with new congressional districts. Wisconsin has all new (and fair!) state maps.
The list goes on, but the mission is clear: Register new voters, educate about election law changes, and turn out pro-voting advocates to make sure everyone's voice is heard in our elections. Our country is depending on us.
New voter registration costs us just about $3 per new voter. Step up to pitch in with $24 or whatever you can today ahead of this year's registration deadlines >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=091024_3&amount=24]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091024_3&amount=25]

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A personal note
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
It wasn’t long ago that my home state was completely written off, year after year. After decades of unified Republican control it was a foregone conclusion that we had no chance of competing here.
#

Hey, it’s Ruben Gallego.
If you’re reading this email it’s a pretty good bet that you’re going to be watching the debate later tonight. You’re no doubt thinking about the last debate, too — along with everything that happened afterwards.
It’s a big deal, and I won’t tell you otherwise. But before it starts, I wanted to try one more time to refocus your attention on Arizona.
It wasn’t long ago that my home state was completely written off, year after year. After decades of unified Republican control, it was a foregone conclusion that we had no chance of competing here.
But that all started changing over the last six years. We organized. We worked hard. We won in 2018. We won in 2020. We won in 2022. And no matter what happens tonight, we need to fight with everything we’ve got to win here again in 2024.
Arizona’s seats could decide which party controls the U.S. House. Whether we win our Senate race is going to determine whether we defend our Senate Majority or lose it. And Trump himself has said that if he wins in Arizona, he will win the presidency.
Those are the stakes, and this is shaping up to be one of the most competitive, most expensive states in the entire country. We can’t lose focus. So, before you tune in to the debate, I need to ask you something very important.
[**Can you use this link to make your first online donation of $5 and help us raise the resources we need to win in Arizona? name: Cinde Warmington
subject: Thank you all.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Cinde Warmington
body:
| Thank you for all of your support throughout this campaign. While we didn’t get the results we wanted tonight, **I am so proud of the fight we gave, and I’m grateful for each one of you.**

I’m proud that we stood up to make housing more affordable for every New Hampshire family.

I’m proud that we stood up to Frank Edulblut and his assault on our public schools.

I’m proud we stood up to get rid of out-of-state trash and stop the garbage coming into our state.

_And you better believe that I am proud of our fight to protect reproductive freedom._

**_This campaign may be over, but our fight continues._**

I called Joyce Craig, and I congratulated her on her victory, and I pledged to fight my heart out to help make sure she is our next Governor. While Joyce and I had a few disagreements during the campaign, we both love this state, and **we both know we have to stop Kelly Ayotte from becoming Governor.**

Because we need a Governor who stands up and fights for women’s reproductive rights, not someone who has spent her entire career trying to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and has spent this entire campaign lying about it.

**We know Donald Trump hired Kelly to help him confirm a Supreme Court justice to overturn _Roe v. Wade._**

We know Kelly spent her career supporting a national abortion ban. And we are not going to let the people of New Hampshire forget the danger she poses to our state.

Just like we aren’t going to let Kelly get away with trying to hide that she spent years shilling for corporations who put profits over people — who jacked up the cost of housing and laid off workers while giving their CEOs massive bonuses.

**Kelly isn't the type of Governor New Hampshire needs or deserves.** That’s why we have to stay in the fight and make sure Joyce Craig wins in November.

_I’m going to do my part, and I hope you will too._ Because this election was never about me — it was about you and the future we want to build for our kids and grandkids.

I want to thank my husband Bill and my entire family for their love and support. I want to thank my campaign team for their passion and their hard work. I want to thank everyone who endorsed this campaign and stood behind me every step of the way. I want to thank everyone who put up a sign, knocked on a door, chipped in a few bucks, or just cheered us on.

It was your love and support that powered this campaign and I can’t thank you enough.

**Tonight, let’s celebrate the campaign we ran._But tomorrow, let’s get to work._**

Thank you so very much,

Cinde

---

Dear Peter,
Tonight, Kamala Harris reminded the rest of America what we’ve always known: she is not only the right choice but the only choice to lead our nation into the future with confidence and capability. She clearly outlined the values of the Harris/Walz ticket—values that strengthen our democracy, protect reproductive freedoms, and ensure that every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead.
In stark contrast, Donald Trump’s performance was a glaring example of his inability to adapt and lead like a true statesman. He was as vengeful, insult-laden, and ego-driven as ever, showing the same destructive tendencies that have defined his entire political career. His refusal to change means we already know what a second Trump term would bring: more chaos, division, and harm.
Remember the turmoil and destruction he caused while in office? Recall the regressive, dangerous agenda laid out in Project 2025, which was exposed during the Democratic National Convention. We can’t afford to go back.
The choice this November could not be clearer. If you believe in Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and the values of basic human decency, now is the time to act. Show your support today by splitting a donation between the Harris Victory Fund and MassDems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/massdemsxharris] . Together, we can take back our country and secure a brighter future.
Your support means the world as we fight for a better tomorrow.
In solidarity,

**Contact:** Griffin Reid, Communications Director, _**[greid@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**_

**_Statement on President Trump's Victory in Tonight's Debate_** **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (September 10, 2024)** – Indiana Republican gubernatorial candidate, Mike Braun, issued the following statement on President Trump's victory in tonight's presidential debate. _**Statement from Indiana GOP Gubernatorial Candidate Mike Braun:**_
---
"Tonight, President Trump took Kamala Harris to task and made her answer for her failed record over the last three and a half years alongside Joe Biden. The Harris-Walz ticket would be a continuation of crippling inflation, wide open borders, and American weakness and instability abroad. We need a leader like President Trump, who has a record of success on all those issues, to put our country back on the right path. I look forward to working with President Trump as Governor to make Indiana a beacon of freedom and opportunity for all Hoosiers.” _###_

body:
Tonight, Vice President Harris further demonstrated that she is the only candidate who will protect our rights and freedoms
#

Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords.
If you just tuned into the presidential debate, I am sure it is clearer than ever that this November, Americans have a critical choice. We have the choice between a leader who will fight for our freedoms and safety, or a politician who will take orders from his gun lobby donors.
Unlike Donald Trump, Vice President Harris demonstrated the courage and compassion this country needs as a leader on tonight’s debate stage. I am so proud to have endorsed Vice President Harris to be our next president. Now, we must keep up our work to make sure she has the resources to win this November.
[**So please, will you rush in a contribution of $3 to GIFFORDS PAC to help us support Vice President Harris and her campaign for president?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240910-2-30&t=1&akid=8910%2E3935704%2EsppPwf)
Vice President Kamala Harris knows that gun violence is a public health crisis, and she has the experience and the courage to take on the gun lobby. Donald Trump, on the other hand, has a proven track record of putting gun lobby profits over our safety.
Under Donald Trump, gun homicides skyrocketed 34%. Earlier this year, Trump bragged at an NRA event that his administration “did nothing” on guns. If he gets elected again, he will bring his same apathy towards gun violence to his next administration. We can’t let that happen.
Tonight, Vice President Harris further demonstrated that she is the only candidate who will protect our rights and freedoms—and I’m proud to stand with her in this must-win race.
[**Can I count on you to join me in supporting Kamala Harris after her successful debate performance by donating $3 to GIFFORDS PAC?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240910-2-30&t=2&akid=8910%2E3935704%2EsppPwf)

To love this country is to fight for its people.
**All people. Working people.** Everyday Americans like bartenders, and factory workers, and fast food cashiers who punch a clock and are on their feet all day in some of the toughest jobs out there.
If you are a working parent trying to afford rent and childcare — Kamala Harris is for you.
If you are a senior who had to go back to work because your retirement didn’t stretch far enough — Kamala Harris is for you.
If you’re an immigrant family just starting your American story — Kamala Harris is for you.
When we knock on our neighbors doors, organize our communities, and elect Kamala Harris to the presidency on November 5th, we will send a loud message that **the people of this nation will not go back**.
We choose a new path, and open the door to a new day: one that is for the people, and by the people.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE **September 10, 2024
Contact: ⁨Alvin Gunnion⁩ — communications@yda.org **

---
**BREAKING: DONALD TRUMP'S CAMPAIGN**
---
WASHINGTON, D.C. — Tonight, Vice President Kamala Harris took the debate stage and showed the country what we already know to be true: Donald Trump is a fraud. Whether it’s lying about his criminal behavior, his disastrous and dangerous track record as President, or about his beliefs and plans for a second term, Trump just can’t help himself when presented with an opportunity to lie to the American people.

What we saw tonight was nothing short of what was promised by the Harris campaign in the lead-up to this debate; **a complete and utter dismantling of Donald Trump’s phony persona** , befitting of a seasoned prosecutor like VP Harris.

Throughout her distinguished career in public service as a Prosecutor, Attorney General, Senator, and as Vice President, Kamala Harris’s only client has been the American people. “With tonight’s performance, Kamala Harris has clearly and concisely built the definitive, irrefutable case against Donald Trump,” **said YDA President Quentin Wathum-Ocama**. “With the stakes of this election higher than ever before, America needs a bold new generation of leadership: that’s Kamala Harris. The Young Democrats of America are fired up and ready to forge a new path for our country. **We’re not going back**.”
---

Kamala Harris and Donald Trump met for their first Presidential debate, and for the first time ever, in Philadelphia. [You can read my real time threads posts here](https://substack.com/redirect/13d969e7-c05e-44f7-873d-d172394284f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Below I provide a comprehensive analysis on 14 of the most salient questions and subjects.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/01abba9b-ac7a-436b-9aff-d069a84cd5ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Kamala Harris focused on passing a $6,000 child tax credit, a $25,000 credit for first time home buyers, lowering cost of prescription drugs, and building on national unity under her "Opportunity Economy." In contrast, Donald Trump said that nine years after he first began running for office he now finally has a concept of an idea for healthcare, said his crowd sizes are bigger than Harris's, repeated the Big Lie about a stolen 2020 election, and says criminal immigrants are getting transgender surgeries in prison while eating your dog. No, that's not hyperbole, that's a quote.
A lot to cover so let's dive in. Likewise, please consider subscribing to support my work and advocacy. **Let 's Address This.**

## Claim 1: Immigrants Are Harming the Country
Donald Trump's favorite scare tactic throughout his speech was to claim there's an "invasion of immigrants killing hundreds of thousands of people a year." Let's break down this blatant falsehood:
* There's no "invasion." Notwithstanding the absurdity of labeling immigrants as "invaders," [undocumented crossings are at a three year ](https://substack.com/redirect/be8b085e-600e-4b0c-9dbc-aea51e235473?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[low](https://substack.com/redirect/be8b085e-600e-4b0c-9dbc-aea51e235473?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _Trump refused to explain his policy of deporting 11M undocumented immigrants, namely how he plans to execute such an undertaking.
* Immigrants are not "killing hundreds of thousands of people a year." In reality, all murders in America combined total around 21,500 annually. Trump fabricated data to fear monger and hope it wins him votes.
* Far from record crime rates as Trump alleged, [America's murder rates are at historic lows](https://substack.com/redirect/ede30794-ce99-41cd-acd4-07ba08394c1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and falling. Again, the facts are inconvenient to Trump so he makes up his own alternative facts as he goes along.
* Trump never mentions that murder rates are [40% higher in red states than in blue states](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c9d9a5-2dab-4743-9766-e5dafc33d0aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and 8 of the top 10 states with highest murder rates are red states. This is in part due to failed "tough on crime" policies that red states espouse. Trump demonizes immigrants to avoid dealing with failed Republican policies.
* Trump is on record that he wants [more white immigrants from 'nice' countries like Norway](https://substack.com/redirect/6d32bd5b-801b-4737-ae7e-a91ffb9178ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but condemns immigrants from _"[sh*thole countries](https://substack.com/redirect/ba67af68-b0b7-42ba-b2e4-003194292b57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),_" i.e. his pejorative for Haiti and African countries. He claims he will support immigration reform, but when this Congress had a bipartisan immigration bill--[Trump told GOP to kill it](https://substack.com/redirect/147fcb73-27d7-49be-8cb4-747daee155d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). When asked why he killed the bill, Trump repeatedly refused to answer.
* Finally, immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have significantly lower crime rates than do born U.S. citizens. This has in fact always been the case. You are statistically safer living next to an immigrant than you are living next to a born U.S. citizen. In fact, a study over a 150 year period found that [immigrants have ](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb1c041-8e21-4fb1-abc0-9a0502d272ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[never](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb1c041-8e21-4fb1-abc0-9a0502d272ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[had a higher crime rate than born U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb1c041-8e21-4fb1-abc0-9a0502d272ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

## Claim 2: Tariffs Will Benefit Americans
Donald Trump has made tariffs a centerpiece of his economic policy, claiming they benefit American families by protecting U.S. jobs.
**Fact check:** Trump fundamentally misunderstands how tariffs work, or, he thinks Americans are too stupid to understand he's lying. Tariffs on imports, such as those imposed on Chinese goods, result in higher prices for American consumers. Experts estimate that Trump's tariffs have cost American families approximately $4,000 per year due to price increases passed down to consumers. His approach has hurt the U.S. economy, raising the cost of living for middle-class families while providing little long-term benefit to domestic industries.
## Claim 3: Post-Birth Abortions
One of Trump's most inflammatory claims is that some states allow "post-birth abortions," a claim he made repeatedly all night long.
**Fact check:** This claim is patently false. There is no such thing as a "post-birth abortion." The very concept is a contradiction of medical and legal definitions. Similarly, Trump's claim about so-called "ninth-month abortions" is misleading. Abortions at that stage of the pregnancy are incredibly rare, never voluntary, and occur only when the life of the mother or the fetus is at risk. The refusal of GOP states to provide this critical life saving healthcare contributes to GOP states representing 16 of the top 17 states with high maternal and infant mortality rates. Asked twice if he would sign a national abortion ban, Trump refuses to answer the question and instead ranted about student loans.
In contrast, Kamala Harris was clear she would sign a national law to protect abortion access and reproductive rights, and ensure government could not supersede a woman's right to personal autonomy.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..5mK80HTwXk0jO_ucU4I7y3i5ClxGPkH3T-ivueBXn8I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148751881)
## Claim 4: America Was Deeply Divided Under Roe v. Wade
Donald Trump recently claimed that the U.S. was deeply divided on abortion rights under Roe v. Wade, and he helped unify the country by overturning Roe.
**Fact check:** Polls show Trump's claim is a lie. More than 72% of Americans supported Roe v. Wade and the right to reproductive healthcare. Contrary to Trump's assertions, abortion is one of the few issues that unites a vast majority of Americans in support of women's rights .
## Claim 5: The Cases Against Trump Are Political Weaponization
Trump insisted that the multiple criminal cases against him, including those for fraud and sexual assault, are part of a politically motivated effort to weaponize the Department of Justice against him.
**Fact check:** These cases were brought based on substantial evidence, not political motivations. Trump has been convicted of fraud and sexual assault, and is facing multiple other charges based on his actions while in and out of office. These are not politically driven accusations, but criminal charges that resulted from judicial investigations. He was convicted not by Joe Biden or Kamala Harris or any political operative, but by a jury of his peers.
Though, Harris did make it a point to point out that for as much as Donald Trump professes to oppose crime, he's a convicted criminal guilty of numerous fraud and sexual crimes.
## Claim 6: Biden Botched the Afghanistan Withdrawal
Donald Trump claimed that his administration ended the war in Afghanistan, criticizing the Biden administration's handling of the withdrawal.
**Fact check:** Trump's own administration negotiated the deal with the Taliban, which bypassed the Afghan government and led to the release of 5,000 Taliban prisoners . While the Biden administration followed through with the withdrawal, the framework was set under Trump's leadership. Trump's failure to prepare for the transition significantly contributed to the chaotic aftermath. Trump himself admits that he set things in motion that Biden could not stop.
Harris said she supported Biden's decision to continue with the Afghanistan withdrawal, and acknowledged the tragic deaths of 13 soldiers.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..5mK80HTwXk0jO_ucU4I7y3i5ClxGPkH3T-ivueBXn8I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148751881)
## Claim 7: Transgender Surgeries for Immigrants
Trump has baselessly accused Kamala Harris of supporting transgender surgeries for undocumented immigrants.
**Fact check:** There is no policy or proposal from Harris or any other Democrat that suggests public funding for transgender surgeries for immigrants . This false narrative is designed to mislead voters, has no grounding in reality, and is nothing more than divisive bigotry.
## Claim 8: Immigrants are eating dogs
Trump claimed immigrants on Ohio are eating dogs, and that it must be true because he saw it on television. Yes he is actually dying on this hill.
**Fact Check:** The moderators quickly fact-checked Trump that they'd spoken to the city manager of the alleged dog eating claims, and found that no such thing happened in any capacity. Trump insisted that it must have happened because he saw it on television, which speaks most to his gullibility or utter incompetence, or perhaps a combination the two. The truth is that if your elderly father or grandfather told you criminal immigrants are getting transgender surgeries in prison while stealing and eating your dog--you'd consider heavy medication or maybe even having them committed. MAGAs want him elected President.
Harris responded to this and other similar claims by pointing out just how extreme Trump is, and how Americans want unity instead.
## Claim 9: Israel and Palestine
The moderators asked both candidates how they would end Israel's siege on Gaza. Neither had a particularly good answer.
**Fact Check:** The moderators pressed Harris on how she would end the siege on Gaza, given that Netanyahu has continued to obstruct a deal and refuses to abide by deals. Harris simply restated that she and Biden are working hard to secure a ceasefire and release of all hostages. However, she refused to entertain any notion of stopping arms to Netanyahu, even as he commits war crimes with those arms. I believe Harris must distance herself from Biden on this issue. More than 61% of Americans want to stop arms to Netanyahu, as do 77% of Democrats.
Trump ranted about how Harris hates Israel and he he would have prevented 10/7 from happening in the first place--again--without any evidence or tangible policy to back up his wild claims. Trump also claimed Harris "hates Arabs." This is likely a ploy to try to attract Arab voters upset about Biden's handling of Israel's siege on Gaza.

## Claim 10: Trump Could End the War in Ukraine
Trump has repeatedly claimed that if he were in office, the war in Ukraine would never have happened, or that he could quickly bring it to an end. There's no evidence of this.
**Fact check:** Trump's foreign policy record contradicts these claims. During his presidency, Trump weakened U.S. alliances by repeatedly criticizing NATO, an essential counterbalance to Russian aggression. His cozy relationship with authoritarian leaders like Vladimir Putin emboldened Russia's actions, leading to instability in Europe. Moreover, Trump's withdrawal of support for Ukraine and failure to hold Russia accountable for its actions would likely have worsened the situation, not prevented it. Experts agree that the unity of NATO, strengthened under Biden's leadership, has been a critical factor in Ukraine's ability to defend itself and maintain its sovereignty.
Despite being asked repeatedly if he wants Ukraine to win this war, Trump refused to answer, or give any explanation exactly _how_ he would bring about an end to Russia's invasion of Ukraine "even before he would be inaugurated."
## Claim 11: The U.S. Economy Was Better Under Trump
Trump often touts his economic record, claiming that the U.S. economy was at its strongest during his presidency. The opposite is true.
**Fact check:** While it's true that the economy saw growth before the COVID-19 pandemic, much of that success was built on policies put in place by previous administrations. Even then, Trump's job growth even prior to the pandemic was slower than Obama's job growth during his first or second term.
Trump's tax cuts for corporations and the wealthy added trillions to the national debt without delivering significant benefits to the middle class or working Americans. Furthermore, the U.S. lost millions of manufacturing jobs during his presidency, despite his claims to the contrary. His trade wars, particularly with China, also hurt American farmers and industries by increasing costs and reducing market access. Economic growth under Trump was not as exceptional as he claims, and the recovery has been shaped more by global trends than his policies.
## Claim 12: Trump Had a Better Healthcare Plan Than the ACA
Trump has repeatedly criticized the Affordable Care Act (ACA), claiming he would implement a superior healthcare plan.
**Fact check:** Throughout his presidency, Trump failed to offer a comprehensive healthcare plan that could replace the ACA. His administration attempted to repeal the ACA multiple times, more than 60 times in fact, but these efforts were blocked in Congress, most notably by Senator John McCain.
Trump's only healthcare "plan" was to dismantle the ACA, which would have left millions of Americans without health insurance, especially those with preexisting conditions. Despite claiming to have an alternative, Trump never presented a viable replacement. In contrast, the ACA continues to provide essential coverage for millions of Americans, while recent reforms under the Biden/Harris administration have reduced prescription drug prices and expanded access to affordable healthcare.

## Claim 13: Peaceful Transfer of Power
On peaceful transfer of power Trump asked about watching the violence and waiting two hours before telling supporters to go home. He accepted no wrongdoing.
**Fact Check:** Asked if he has any regrets on January 6, Trump refuses to answer the question. Instead he brought up Ashlee Babbit, a violent insurrectionist who was killed by law enforcement after refusing to comply with lawful orders to stop invading the Capitol. Trump instead condemned law enforcement for protecting the Capitol from Ashlee Babbit and other insurrectionists. Trump defended the January 6 rioters, who he has promised to pardon and release if reelected, and blamed former Speaker Nancy Pelosi for not giving 10K national guard troops. This is also a lie, of course, as ordering the troops was within his jurisdiction and he declined to do so.
Kamala Harris responded that she was at the Capitol that day, and put the blame squarely on Trump for inciting violence. She noted that 140 police officers were injured that day and that some died. She also pointed out Trump was impeached for his violence.
## Claim 14: The Big Lie
Donald Trump was asked about his recent remarks saying that he "lost by a whisper." He claimed he was being sarcastic, and still won the 2020 election.
**Fact Check:** Trump stated that he stands by the Big Lie that the 2020 election was stolen. He went on to claim our elections our "bad and Democrats are getting illegal immigrants to vote." Both of these claims are lies. Our elections are secure and there is zero evidence that non-citizens can vote. The moderators correctly noted to him that 60+ judges looked at the evidence and ruled against him on the merits--a fact Trump still refuses to acknowledge.
Asked about Trump's threats to prosecute his political opponents, Kamala Harris responded that "Donald Trump was fired by 81 million Americans." This clearly got under Trump's skin. Harris went on to point out that world leaders are laughing at Trump, and that court cases show Trump has lost the election repeatedly.
## Conclusion
Throughout the debate, Harris continued to bait Trump, and Trump continued to take the bait. Harris baited Trump on crowd size, on his $400M inheritance, on John McCain, and on his felony convictions. Harris continued to stare Trump down when she spoke, while Trump continued to look down when she spoke to him. Harris ignored several notable questions, namely, are you better off now than four years ago, and why she no longer supporters universal healthcare. However, she thoroughly portrayed her vision of a future built on economic justice, American unity, and giving working people a fighting chance. It was a clear, inviting vision.
Trump largely refused to answer any question at all. He instead used his time to repeatedly attack Harris with what you would find on a Q-Anon post. I mean, I still can't believe Trump actually claimed and then insisted that Haitian immigrants are stealing and eating dogs.

These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.

Dear
Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn
asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take
our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your
input.

If so,
here is a link to the survey:

Sincerely,

Hillsdale
College

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From:
Larry P. Arnn
Subject:
Survey on an urgent matter

Friend,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63542208:WyZkFhWNM:m:3:2627245898:FC7FFE3F25CED7E01D06D0A90B89428A:r

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as ";Constitution 101" and ";The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63542208:WyZkFhWNM:m:3:2627245898:FC7FFE3F25CED7E01D06D0A90B89428A:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been ";pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection. By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Today marks 23 years since the 9/11 terror attacks. Freedom isn't free and we've all been to way to many funerals since 9/11. Sadly, today we are more likely than not to have another terrorist attack. We pray God will protect our country and the American people. Where were you on 9/11/2001? Stay vigilant, lets's keep an eye on each other, and let's never forget.

name: Julia Kortrey, Evergreen
subject: REMINDER: Webinar today on new PA pollution reduction program
body:
RSVP to learn more about this game-changer for industry and labor
| | |
---
| Hey there,

I wanted to make sure you saw my email about today's webinar on RISE PA—a new pollution reduction program in Pennsylvania that will incentivize industrial decarbonization projects while creating good jobs and ensuring equitable workforce development. **It takes place at noon EST** and we have an incredible lineup of experts, including PA DEP's Louie Krak, joining us!

[**Let us know if you can make it or would like us to send you the recording.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850553/87SdQ4wZ) You can read more details below.

– Julia

\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Julia Kortrey, Evergreen Collaborative
Date: Thur, Sept 5, 2024
Subject: A game-changer for industry and union labor in PA |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850554/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
|
## ⚡EVENT ALERT⚡
Join us, Ohio River Valley Institute, PA DEP, Conservation Voters of PA, and labor and industry groups to discuss a game-changing Pennsylvania pollution reduction program that will create upward of 6,000 new jobs! The conversation takes place **next Wednesday, September 11 at 12 p.m. ET.** [RSVP NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850555/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Friend—

Earlier this summer, the Biden-Harris administration awarded **$4.3 billion** in Climate Pollution Reduction Implementation Grants to select states, cities, and coalitions.

And Pennsylvania is getting **a whopping $396 million of it** to cut industrial pollution across the state.

How? By implementing a new program called **Reducing Industrial Sector Emissions in Pennsylvania (RISE PA)** , which will provide grants and incentives to industrial facilities for decarbonization projects, while creating jobs with prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements that ensure equitable workforce development.

In fact, it’s estimated that RISE PA will decrease climate pollution by 9.2 million metric tons of climate pollution cumulatively between 2025 and 2050 (the equivalent of powering _over 2 million homes for a year!_)—making it a slingshot into the more equitable clean energy future we all want and deserve.

**We're excited to dive deeper into this incredible program next Wednesday, September 11 at 12 p.m. ET.**[**If you want to know more about RISE PA and what it means for industry, labor, and the climate, you should join us!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850556/87SdQ4wZ) |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850557/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
[RSVP NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850558/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| We're bringing together industrial leaders, labor groups, and Pennsylvania environmental organizations to talk about RISE PA and what happens next. You'll hear from me and: |
---
|
* **Jeff Mauk** , Director, Policy Network, Eastern Region, CERES
* **Rob Bair** , President, PA Building and Construction Trades Council
* **Katie Blume** , Political and Legislative Director, Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania
* **Louie Krak** , Infrastructure Implementation Coordinator, PA Department of Environmental Protection
* **Joanne Kilgour** , Executive Director, Ohio River Valley Institute

|
---
| By tackling the state's biggest source of climate pollution, RISE PA will make sure Pennsylvania residents experience improved air quality, along with more good-paying job opportunities. But to effectively do so, the program needs to solicit as much feedback as possible during the next few months.

**Don't miss this opportunity to learn more about RISE PA and how it will help communities like yours thrive.**[**RSVP today!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2850556/87SdQ4wZ)

And bring your questions!

See you online, |
---
| | |
---
### Julia Kortrey
Deputy State Policy Director
Evergreen Collaborative
---
---

---
| _Evergreen is building the ambitious, actionable policy roadmap for an all-out mobilization to defeat climate change—and to create millions of jobs in a thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future. None of this would be possible without your support._ |

| | Dear Fellow American,

Are you enjoying your _Imprimis_ subscription?

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most interesting conservatives each month?

I hope so.

You will never have to pay for _Imprimis_ because we want its message in defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many citizens as possible.

We're grateful that you read _Imprimis_ , and we hope you share your copy with others after you've read it--and that you encourage others you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale relies on a nationwide network of supporters--people like you--to help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and strong national defense.

You're a longtime _Imprimis_ subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our country.

And you understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate the American people about our founding principles of liberty...the importance of reviving limited constitutional government...the need to defend the rule of law...and the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free enterprise.

**[That's why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale College.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d63d1bc824c94a88a62a74dd13fd980d&_e=HAbxcKUJM2pkfiGiyxxNbl4jDXgJmY_g9Msu_-rQZ3g1huVF1gN0nlu4tJzXAd-j3JL47mFONfmCoTib-3S459_1Yf2O_gaZg0YlwtOelN8U-qNZQMmRzh_0c8Xf8ADK0UHGdCO6Sm1mL1QBGY-5Z-OyErbDajj2VeMWvBiWbtiIpCzx1tTAIE0s8YTYUZ6ZQtlm9m9yNJ5GlE-1kQhij6HMMFg5nU_WQqwNmukEaBT0oQ15ZnXzX2qQPnhOgtdB8Wr_zGcKtU8iEbFRCHqv1wj9O-1MKkDpPYlTX3IFsYNGly3l4Lf_ziHHxxfp-qD3CpuMI6ufXk4xufl86SD9Ks_sV8WGf_p6EBvH9JKKJG2PGZuD_HCiix7hV84IhU3Qhe8TIKH8LpkZ2C6bjYfmtg%3D%3D) **

**Will you help?**

In addition to sending _Imprimis_ to more Americans, you will help us...

* Teach Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American Heritage, the Great Books, and more through **free online courses (to date, more than _4 million students_ have registered for one or more courses)**;

* Launch and support dozens more **classical K-12 schools** nationwide--schools where students receive an education rooted in the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands more are on waiting lists.

Your support is especially needed today because **Hillsdale College does not accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. We refuse to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

## Trump, Harris Battle Through Debate
The first presidential debate between former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris Tuesday night was often contentious, with both candidates often turning [to personal attacks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngS0Rd1AwA0MXb-na0QJzxFdhY9nIVd6-aufOv_7h-3xMj8iVt-dHXCn00qY4d75o8jeAG5rJyBwKEZKWFMChVVYDaLmEZHRB1KUkyj5ZiJg15Dm9KZ9n45zkgAqN8gCglEN7HwjADDEVO6QY0QujKHNvx_2r8dYXKvXVLjruc1tlDUvv-yn0u8BR4Li99nb23yRwlEfI-zfXyqd1wqjnGrn-bf1_xBXwJwAA__9AcUkK).The debate lasted about 1 hour and 45 minutes and on several occasions, ABC moderator David Muir argued with Trump over his statements while Harris watched.Both nominees attempted to outline their futures for America with Harris focusing on the middle class and Trump on rebuilding the economy and national security.Harris tried to distance herself from President Biden while describing her potential presidency as a change agent that would move the country forward.Trump countered by highlighting the numerous failed policies under the Biden administration.In the closing arguments, Harris reiterated her focus on the future and the middle class, leading Trump to ask, "[Why hasn't she done it?](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uxCAQBOCnwR0nds0ZU1CkcXdpU1oLLGci_COb8ylvHzl1pv2KGc3XY3xQLnl5ftLMrqZ1pFDzyaOVABL1qJvoEjNy27ADg53qWoC2mRzcId0NWWN0AO-DVhiQ7tBHY3qbuMkOFWplAUApg92tZwDdk09d74nQCq045rrut-81L3XiVH7Wk_dbWOemuKnW7RDth8BB4EDbwu_jIoFDyScLHCba93zIur_mTUb2VFly4VDzusirXL62SJUPga26AhZk5EQygiVJNhmZOPlgfbq42V3c3rmUfHRGaPWcKZe_NfX_b06HvwEAAP__SsFkFA)" while in office for the past 3.5 years.

Friend -- On this day 23 years ago, my husband and I were on opposite sides of the Washington, D.C. Beltway at traffic islands, distributing a broadsheet with an August 24th message from Lyndon LaRouche, warning of a potential for terrorist mobs to strike the nation's capitol. His reasoning was as follows: "The world is presently gripped by the biggest, most deep-going, most deadly financial and monetary crisis since Europe of the middle to late Fourteenth Century. We are in a period in which economic and related circumstances have made the idea of regular modern warfare a sick joke, in which regional and other 'little wars,' terrorism, political assassinations, and other forms of destabilization, are leading items on the agendas of many of the strategic planners. The financial and monetary crisis in its presently advanced stage, drives desperate political forces to the brink, desperate political forces who would rather drive civilization itself to the brink, than tolerate the changes in financial and monetary institutions which the present crisis-situation demands. "Washington, D.C. has become a very shabby sort of world power, but it is still the leading world power. Any movement which would terrify official Washington and its environs into fleeing under its beds, would be a major strategic threat to the peace of the world at large, just as the Jacobin Terror of 1789-1794 led fatefully to those Napoleonic wars which dominated Europe until the conclusion of that Vienna Congress which sowed the seeds of the later catastrophes to come." While the form of the terror attack was not precisely as LaRouche expected, on September 11, 2001, the attack occured with the precise intended effect he had forecast. As he warned, terror was unleashed among leading circles in the United States, and the American people were stampeded into a series of wars abroad, and fascist surviellance and censorship at home from which we have never recovered. Americans younger than 30 years of age have never known a time when our nation was not at war, or when we were not being manipulated by lying press and social media algorithms, and having our every text, email, spoken word, and travel history made available to any government agency which wanted it. Consider that! My campaign is dedicated to learning the truth about what happened on September 11, reversing the assault on the freedom of the American people, and ending the wars abroad. If you elect me as your U.S. Senator, I will demand a whole new investigation, including into the funding of that massive terror attack, and the unsavory deal called "al Yamamah" made between former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and her British Aerospace, (a company in which Sen. Gillibrand's father-in-law played an executive role) and Saudi Prince Bandar, for weapons in exchange for petroleum. I will welcome testimony from NSA whistleblowers Bill Binney and Kirk Wiebe, and will demand a document release from various intelligence agencies to find out what they have been hiding from the American people about this horrible turning point in American and world history. Searching for the truth and demanding justice takes courage and love -- love of what is beautiful about mankind which makes humanity worth fighting for. To that end, I would like to invite all of you to attend in person, or over the Youtube livestream, the 9/11 Memorial Concert of the Schiller Institute NYC Chorus, which will occur on Sunday, September 15 at 5:00 pm at Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church in the Bronx. ## Texas Farms Hit by Water Shortage
Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller warned the state is facing a [severe water shortage](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO2zAQRL-G6tagVqQpFirSqLu0KY2VuLIXoEiDpKy7vw_OaQIE6QZvBgPM_Pq4fZBESfeftPPUPrd8o7XJi28e-h7Q3EwXpkUH33c89Q6v2jrUpntMi1lcGIN1dgnoDJnBsQ_DuOrBL3ownUyo0Wjf972218FexmEbR-2QrTVmXVAZzUFaLpf24MafVLf4lV9cLmveuzg9WntWNfxQOCucz_O8nBvRt6lwptJkjaxwTnxWhfMzR2myfktJVQLDX-Td_i-ge5H1iO0oDGved6lVcuICNR8pAEUqO1T6qvAnLxXKkZKkO-SjQd7gpMZF4Yyjg81vTMNI4Mk5MNtoYTHegsMQPF_DQo67MoXnKTFKvTpl9H0nie-97T_3vyb8HQAA__8co4m0), particularly impacting agriculture. Miller reported Texas was losing about [one farm per week](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAUAL8GOjbwRMCC4hq7vfZKw8pTX4KwQeKuf3-57a-eZCaZn_t0D5Qor99hR9_eS5nC3OjEaRBKCdCT5tE_ZBwUR68sGNlbkJpv3kbrjIrKgQFnDSwYAOagoVPa9Y_AyYMELQellOxN199ctzgnLWDfaz0_gGmJkVqpt7Zhw3c4lnSVE-ttLjtPfmvtebDui8HIYGwbbpTSH2MwPkui-WIwYsa6XgLzSbXkHXNjMGpnBmeM-EjFKzSsYq500CEqFbHWkCMyGHn18fmilOgwlmm57oE-Bd7-mXF6-A0AAP__xGRhOw) due to water scarcity, highlighting the Rio Grande Valley as particularly affected. He cited examples of agricultural decline: tomato production had nearly vanished in the Rio Grande Valley, the Winter Garden area's vegetable crop yield had dropped 80%, and Pecos cantaloupe farming had ceased as wells ran dry. Miller [proposed solutions](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFuhDAQAF9jOpC9LBgKF2noLm1KtNjLYclgBCu4-32U69OPZqT5eYwPiiluz29a2clrziN5iRePfWlMCThiEdykQ28KdsZCqxsLGovFkQVtfPCmDpZonsGaGVrrsQtGT_1URAcaUPfGGN20dVN19dx12gI3DaKfQKHmECUflSws_KJzTu988VH5vBbJLSL7qeovBYOC4b7van2ftNEmeYv5D1IwbHyfCoaUPSUFAx0SfWIFw0dY3iR8lOeSD6Enl6a3DSBitS97cbiw3zGleLZWoX6uFNMnLf-cuBz8BgAA__-DmmDr) including stormwater capture, water recycling, and using brackish water for fracking, emphasizing the urgent need for action.
## Southwest Chairman to Exit
Southwest Airlines announced a significant board restructuring on Tuesday, with [longtime Chairman Gary Kelly set to retire](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb8Gd1gwgJ0UFK9xl9duaQ1mHKNgEwEJyd-vkn7be3Wko_NzmS8YYjiu_3EnW19rmnGp4UnzmUvJQc-689YJf5YdWTnCIMwIQnebHVckr9VqNPkFlHKrdDAIPXgnwaixCxYEaHGWUgozKNOf1Ho6iRHIGK0XB0wL8qGm3NeNKr2wrPGdnpT7Je1dtFut98LUPwYTg6m11i-uHNTK52cwfREG02diMJX0qFujUjmGHMNBhZcNb_S4c5cwe75sGPKOB79ifvMbxfhmMHXZ-nsLMYYyjEyL644hfg3qH0GeFn4DAAD__5gQZO8) next year and six board members to resign in November. This move comes after pressure from major shareholder Elliott Investment Management, which has built a 10% stake in the airline and advocated for changes to improve financial performance. The airline plans to appoint four new board members and will share an updated business plan at its upcoming investor day in Dallas. The company's stock [dropped 3% on the news](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtu4zAURL-G6ijwpVfBwouFOm-zAVIK1-SVRYQUFZKy7L8P5D7tDDCYcz6v0xWcd-v9HwTU5TnHCUxxD5wGyjkValKV1TdmB16h5p1oWdMJpqpFC5BDB7bpoEc-3KyRre3tMDDZStZxUzktmFBs4JyzppVN3cu571knsGmUMjdBFEPrSkx1WbDgE_LsX_GBqTYxVF4vpWyZyAsRIxHjcRx1yOvZETHiSvdMxBjiii8iRhPDBqvDM8txL8uBudC8QMJMZ_CeSgqZvuFcLplue15o3As1C7gUYKV3SC_6hd6fe5Do5cK_fT9_EDlG4yyRf_-covDI_zFtVdJ2O5z3LrcdUewewPn38fKLx4cWPwEAAP__wB53Gg).
## Tony the Escaped Tiger Captured in Mexico
A 400-pound Bengal tiger named Tony, with a taste for freedom, was [finally apprehended](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1urDAQQOGnMR3IHvwDhYvb0O1tUyJjD8tIBiOYLGyePkr69Ec60vfxGB-BMm3P_2FFz_dcxhCZXjj2tVI16FFXyU8y9apCrxxYaRxIXS3eBaU6a501sdW27-eUJj27KbXOoVS2Ig8StOyVUtLY1jRdO3eddIDGaB0nEFpiIi5Hwwsy3uGc87u88GhiWavsF-b9FO0_AYOA4bquZn2fYQsbl43KTyRg2PA6BQy5xJAFDOFgihkFDExPPOoYdv48MNUr3hRL_VVKrXpntLay2Ze9OnzaL8qZTuuEls81UP798x8cLw_fAQAA___qP2In) after a seven-day Mexican adventure that kept South Texas on high alert, officials reported. The feline fugitive, who had slipped out of Quinta La Fauna Zoo in Reynosa, Mexico, on Sept. 3, was caught just 5 miles from the U.S. border at midnight Tuesday in Los Longoria. [See a photo of Tony here](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ8GOpB9_IcLF7dJl9tuiRz7OBzJxMhYgX37FdG2232aGemT5us-3z1lej3_-xVdO1OZfWj0xtkOnA8gZ9lH92DR8h4dN6CZMsBkvzgVkjbcaiHB-BCMjho0YwbQTIrH1JMDBpJZzjlTWqhxEmmaroFSUoYHdJJhpFbq2BZsePo95e_yxjqGsvbZLa1teyf-dXDr4HYcxxiWWl5X28EtU8Irphx_0ddGIV-Ee_AbxqHRE-uw4kmhDB_DwK1Rggk7bsvWVxe3g3KmXZtOsufqKX_k7Y8v3g5-AgAA__9L9GBc). Mexican officials [confirmed the capture](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LFu6yAUxvGnwRsWHMDAwHB1JdQhSZdKHS1isHMkHCybxMnbV-7e-Rt-n_7f5_4cMON9uoQ5ufoaSx-Gis_UW8o5BdnLJrori5Y3yXENHVMamGxuTttBqOsYpeqU7bgYrZKcaym6KIwB06ADBpJZzjlTnVCtEaMxTENSSsrhCkSyFLGWta23VNMrbGN-l2da26HMTXa3WpeNiH8EPAG_73v7WPDYCPjPGPtL2jcC_lAIeGYJeM4I-Dm9cCg0bUNYUqQVp7TSU9noqdynsmKgHxhDngr9Xx73-qZfh03AWwCuQVkjFXACvlldXHbMGbdOE8mmOWD-PVf_aPV08BMAAP__LjxnTw), ending a wild game of cat-and-mouse that had prompted warnings from the Hidalgo County Sheriff's Office across the Rio Grande.

East Africa has just endured its worst drought in 40 years, leaving tens of millions without access to clean water, wiping out millions of livestock, and destroying crops. With domestic food production crippled, Somalia has relied heavily on imports--90% of its wheat coming from Russia and Ukraine--until those shipments stopped. Now, two in five children in Somalia suffer from acute malnutrition, and cholera is spreading in some regions. Are you enjoying your _Imprimis_ subscription?

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most interesting conservatives each month?

I hope so.

You will never have to pay for _Imprimis_ because we want its message in defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many citizens as possible.

We're grateful that you read _Imprimis_ , and we hope you share your copy with others after you've read it--and that you encourage others you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale relies on a nationwide network of supporters--people like you--to help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and strong national defense.

You're a longtime _Imprimis_ subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our country.

And you understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate the American people about our founding principles of liberty...the importance of reviving limited constitutional government...the need to defend the rule of law...and the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free enterprise.

**[That's why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale College.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=24e1490218354362ba4e943639a2c24e&_e=jR1_m1_L_HaXVJslQaVWRk5d7jU7F29MQ85t4r_a_B8vLB28BQ68947H4qRc-MiAUZt75XGqCkqXSgd9pN4ICSKsu8oJv1HNbne20T3Sh2NVY-08beT36UllhhQf5SRxydF_JtlmcqiMPlnK3qYg9vPwCyKwJK_XfXvsiXtUtc0oFW-cTOrGpTSi_OMtutpgsg6C-4HZpPfHXE6AtHPGbw5tQH3LpJLe7DByLDqFaIRVprjQMLdyTtrt8kcYUf4HvdrEb5wX8xF-ZqMT5nCpiWaMzB0PYoLsK8ZIM38zvfWUayv4UjW_0QdedV7IcnzjfdgVFKDMYh0Cm8YN1um13h0RQIFO2Mq6SHQA78tnE7fZSNOiSNwHAlZnWaTNT-jIwHg8r9Asex-Lizwltv7xsQ%3D%3D) **

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: In remembrance
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
I will never forget
| | |
---
Friend,

None of us will forget where we were on this day 23 years ago. More than two decades later, the horrific images are still clear in my mind: Burning, collapsing buildings — a nation under attack and cities living through terror. Thousands of Americans senselessly killed. It remains one of the darkest days in our nation's history.
In remembrance, my heart is with the families of 9/11 victims — of spouses, parents, children, and friends who've endured many years without somebody they love, somebody taken from them that day. We must also never forget the bravery of passengers who brought down Flight 93. Without their sacrifice, even more innocent lives would have been taken by terrorists.
There's something else I remember from that day 23 years ago. Maybe you remember it too: bravery and unity. First responders ran to the scene without flinching, many sacrificing their own lives in the process. Communities came together. As a nation, we were there for one another. We supported each other through the grief and shock.

It's a solemn reminder that, even in the gravest of times, there's nothing we can't overcome when we are united.

Let us never forget.

— Debbie
|

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A day that means a lot to me
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I was a Marine reservist on the morning of 9/11. About four years later I deployed to Iraq in the Global War on Terror. It changed my life forever.
#

Peter — 9/11 is a somber day for all Americans, and especially for my generation of veterans.
I was a Marine reservist on the morning of 9/11. About four years later I deployed to Iraq in the Global War on Terror. It changed my life forever.
After I came home I ran for Congress to help the people I served with. What I found was that our country had fallen short of the commitments it made to the few who serve. I took it on myself to smooth their transition home, to make sure they got recognition, that they and their families got the services they earned, the care they needed.
We’ve made great strides since then, investing in the VA and providing additional support to help veterans find work and return to civilian life. We got the PACT Act across the finish line, delivering much needed care for veterans suffering serious illness from toxic exposures. But there’s more work to be done.
After all that progress, the worst possible thing that can happen would be to hand power back to people like Donald Trump and Kari Lake.
We’re moving year-end budget proposals in Congress and the Republican starting point includes a shortfall of $12 billion for the VA. Seriously. That’s care for veterans who served that will be unfunded. That’s their priority, and it’s a slap in the face.
Trump has made his feelings about the people who serve absolutely clear. He called Americans who made the ultimate sacrifice “suckers” and “losers,” he’s attacked Gold Star families, denigrated the Medal of Honor, and he held a campaign photo-op at our most sacred national cemetery, Arlington. We’re props to him, nothing more.
Trump can never again become Commander in Chief, and we cannot allow people like Kari Lake to hand him a Senate Majority.
I’m doing everything I can to prevent that from happening, because this is the most important election of our lifetime. Today, it would mean the world to me if you could stand with me.
[**Can you take a few seconds and add your name to the thousands of others who have personally endorsed my campaign for U.S. Senate? I’m going to need a massive team behind me to be successful, and it would mean a lot to have you with me.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/personal_endorse_em_sept24/?source=em240911-1-160&akid=3054%2E734936%2E8q6oul)
[ ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/personal_endorse_em_sept24/?source=em240911-1-160&akid=3054%2E734936%2E8q6oul)
Thanks for listening. And Semper Fi.
Ruben

Inflation is higher than we've seen in decades, the price of groceries has increased dramatically and you can barely pay your bills. But, local politician have decided they need more of your money.
The Tippah County Board of Supervisors will hold a public hearing on its proposed budget for fiscal year 2024-25 on Friday, September 13, 2024 at 10:00 a.m. in the Board Room of the Chancery Building. At this time, **a proposed ad valorem tax revenue in-crease in the proposed budget** will be considered.
The County of Tippah is now operating with projected total budget revenue of $23,698,489. Eighty (80%) percent or $18,850,395 of such revenue is obtained through ad valorem taxes. For next fiscal year, the proposed budget has total projected revenue of $24,342,420. Of that amount, $19,117,284 is broken down as follows: $10,016,427 is projected to be raised for Tippah County general operations and $9,100,858 is projected to be raised for education.
The equivalent numbers for 2023-2024 were $9,875,161 for general operations and $8,975,235 for education. This increase in ad valorem tax revenue means that **you will pay more in ad valorem taxes on your home, automobile tag, business fixtures and equipment and rental real property.** A millage rate of 80.06 will produce the same amount of revenue from ad valorem taxes for Tippah County as was collected the prior year. The millage rate for the prior year was 80.17.
A millage rate of 56.19 will produce the same amount of revenue from ad valorem taxes for the South Tippah School District as was collected the prior year. The millage rate for the prior year was 54.81.
A millage rate of 54.81 will produce the same amount of revenue from ad valorem taxes for the North Tippah School District as was collected the prior year. The millage rate for the prior year was 52.95.
Any citizen of Tippah County is invited to attend this public hearing on the proposed ad valorem tax revenue increase in the budget and will be allowed to speak for a reasonable amount of time and offer tangible evidence before any vote is taken.

body:
You and I live in a time in which our freedom is in grave danger...

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ib1g8WC3cmcE0MVvXQckvw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoxC86P0SuaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY2xhc3NpY2FsLWdyZWVjZS1hbmQtcm9tZS1jY2E_c2M9MDE2NTZOMDI0MkwwNkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWdyZWVjZXJvbWVjY2EmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtT0dULTIwMjQwOTExVwNzcGNCCmbhPZHhZnscWUBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

**You and I live in a time in which our freedom is in grave danger ...**

* The far Left routinely violates the Constitution in ways reminiscent of despotisms such as the Soviet Union and Maoist China.

* Recent events demonstrate that the consent of the governed has been replaced by a government of the elites, by the elites, and for the elites.

* The promise of equal justice for all is being turned into weaponized justice against anyone who _dares_ to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

Is it any wonder that so many of our fellow citizens feel threatened by the government that is supposed to protect our rights?

**In this time of crisis for our country, the classics can help us to think more clearly about America 's future and how we can change course. That's [why Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on classical Greece and Rome.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ib1g8WC3cmcE0MVvXQckvw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoxC86P0SuaHR0cHM6Ly9pbmZvLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvY2xhc3NpY2FsLWdyZWVjZS1hbmQtcm9tZS1jY2E_c2M9MDE2NTZOMDI0MkwwNkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWdyZWVjZXJvbWVjY2EmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtT0dULTIwMjQwOTExVwNzcGNCCmbhPZHhZnscWUBSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about ancient Greece and Rome--including the rise and fall of Athenian democracy and the Roman Republic.

The video series also considers the significant contributions to Western Civilization of poets such as Homer and Virgil and political philosophers such as Xenophon and Cicero.

The founders of our country looked to classical Greece and Rome as their "lamp of experience."

**The study of the classics encourages a love of liberty, which is why it was once considered an essential element of a liberal arts education. **

But today, it has disappeared from most college and university curricula.

Dear USO Supporter,
Today we pause to remember.
Twenty-three years ago, our nation faced an unimaginable tragedy on September 11 -- a day that left deep scars on the heart of America. Whether we lost loved ones or a piece of ourselves, we continue to reflect on that dark day and how, in our nation's hour of greatest need, we stood together as one.
On this National Day of Service and Remembrance, we honor the memory of the 2,977 lives taken from us. We thank the first responders and all those who courageously answered the call to serve and help save hundreds of lives. We also salute those who have since stepped up to protect and defend our country. Your country is forever grateful.
Since that fateful day in 2001, thousands of brave Americans have enlisted in the Armed Forces. They've made life-changing sacrifices, leaving behind their loved ones, setting aside their personal ambitions and risking their lives for the freedoms we hold dear.
**Today, we remember those we 've lost and honor the dedication of all our heroes in uniform who have served -- and who continue to serve our country every day. **
Thank you for being a part of this community of dedicated military supporters. On a day like today, I'm proud to stand united with you.
With solemn gratitude,
J.D. Crouch II
CEO & President, USO
P.S. Join us as we collect 50,000 signatures honoring our service members on this important day. **[If you haven't signed the card yet, please add your name to honor these heroes. ](https://links.e.uso.)**

name: John Avlon
subject: Meeting the worst of humanity with the best of humanity
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends,

As we remember 9/11, I wanted to take a moment and share a few reflections. In the aftermath of the attacks, I wrote an essay - which I’m attaching to this email - called “The Resilient City.” It captures the tenor of the time and every year I hear from people, including families of the nearly 500 Long Islanders who died on 9/11, who read the essay on this difficult anniversary.
I hope it also rekindles memories of how we met the worst of humanity with the best of humanity - and how we have an obligation to live up to the example of those heroes who ran into the fire to save their fellow citizens.

They did not die to see our nation tear itself apart just two decades later. It’s a reminder that we need to put country over party - and that there is always more that unites us than divides us as Americans.
I’m also honored to have taken part in a conversation with my dear friend, Beth Hatton. You’ll read about her husband Terry - the Captain of FDNY Rescue 1 - in the essay below. I’m not sure I’ll ever experience a more humbling, powerful, or emotional moment like we shared during this conversation.

Watch Beth’s thoughts about service and what keeping promises means to her >> [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=64RV9NrWgx8]
Read my reflection in its entirety below, and I hope you’ll take a minute to reflect and share these words with someone you think needs to hear them today.

With Appreciation,
John
