Hi, friend, thank you for being a part of this grassroots team to flip Florida blue. Your support truly means so much to me.
**I want to take a moment to tell you a bit about my record and why I'm in this race.[(Recent polling shows me statistically tied with Rick Scott, so if you're already all in to flip Florida blue, you can make a gift here.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92629528/497763277/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1851-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2YzNDVhYzgtODc3MC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=trdCQzUkhQyldWJdwZ_N9hwzUwqaf1Ag5hoCPuvpe4k=)**
My mother brought my sisters and me to America when I was 14 to give us a chance at a better life. It took long hours, hard work, and a whole lot of hope, but we were able to win our American Dream. **That's why I made the decision to spend my career giving back to this incredible country and the state that gave me so much.**
I worked at several nonprofit organizations across Florida, helping to protect our wildlife and preserve our coral reefs. During my time working at Florida International University, I helped lead a new **program to** **improve access to affordable health care** for more Floridians.
In 2018, I decided to take these fights to Washington. I ran for Congress in a tough battleground district — and I won. In the House, **I wrote the bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage,** to ensure that more Americans could get the vital care they deserve. I also worked with Republicans to provide **economic relief to families and small businesses** and secured $200 million for **Everglades restoration. **
Throughout my time in Congress, **I fought tirelessly for commonsense gun safety reforms** , serving as the vice chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. This issue is deeply personal to me: When I was 24, my father was killed by a criminal with a gun. After leaving Congress, I joined Gabby Giffords' advocacy group as a senior advisor and continued to fight for safer communities and an end to the gun lobby's grip on Washington.
I'm incredibly proud of the work that I've done to uplift and protect my community. I'll never hide from my record. But I don't think that my opponent can say the same. **Rick Scott has spent his time in power writing the plan to cut Social Security and Medicare, attempting to undermine our elections, attacking our rights, and making it harder for working families to get ahead**. It's no wonder his approval ratings are tanking.
**My opponent is ranked as one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot this year, but I can only defeat him with strong grassroots support.[So please, if you have anything extra to spare, will you make a donation now to help me hit my critical $150,000 fundraising goal before my midnight deadline? I'm counting on you to have my back right now so we can defeat Rick Scott and win a better future for Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92629531/497763279/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1851-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2YzNDVhYzgtODc3MC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=trdCQzUkhQyldWJdwZ_N9hwzUwqaf1Ag5hoCPuvpe4k=)**

That's why I made the decision to spend my career giving back to this incredible country and the state that gave me so much. * **TOP NEWS**

**" Francine comes closest to Houston before making Louisiana landfall,"** Houston Chronicle's **Justin Ballard** -- "Houston won't be anywhere near the [worst weather associated with Francine](https://substack.com/redirect/d8d393e5-d84f-445b-af43-468af7d1c00f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this week as the storm makes its final approach to Louisiana on Wednesday.

But Southeast Texas is expected to contend with occasional wind-whipped showers and rough surf Wednesday. So when will the risk of coastal flooding along the upper Texas Gulf Coast dwindle?

**Minimal rain threat for Houston**

Scattered downpours are most likely to occur in the Houston metro area along and east of Interstate 45. Similar to the showers that pushed through Houston on Tuesday, Wednesday's rain will likely be enough to result in wet roads and standing water -- but don't worry too much about street flooding. Wind gusts of 20 to 30 mph are possible at times as Francine bypasses Houston.

Along the coast, showers will continue, especially through the early afternoon. Downpours will be scattered at best and brief. Rainfall totals of an inch to 3 inches are expected, mainly from Galveston to Beaumont. [Coastal flood alerts](https://substack.com/redirect/dc01f92f-d04e-49b6-8898-346481f172e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will continue as water piles up along the shore. Areas that dealt with rising water during Tropical Storm Alberto in June are likely to see it again Wednesday.

Beach closures and flood-prone coastal roads may be affected by the [1 to 3 feet storm surge](https://substack.com/redirect/de4d5c3e-848b-4f74-8794-1d0447c0541a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) forecast for the region. Wind gusts of 35 to 45 mph are possible at times, but this will not be enough to result in prolific power outages." [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/5cd76f3b-9a51-4bab-86dc-9724caf5480a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

**" Abbott says potential power outages from Tropical Storm Francine will be restored within hours,"** Texas Tribune's **Pooja Salhotra** -- "Tropical Storm Francine could bring life-threatening storm surge, dangerous winds and high water on Texas roadways along the Gulf Coast, Gov. **Greg Abbott** said Tuesday morning, urging Texans to heed advice from their local officials and remain vigilant because the storm could still change course.

Galveston County Judge **Mark Henry** issued a [voluntary evacuation order](https://substack.com/redirect/13ed7fd3-10ce-444c-ac06-eda9fd9dc09b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the Bolivar Peninsula through Wednesday evening because flooding and high tides could hamper travel to and from the peninsula, leaving vulnerable people at-risk.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/c2c59f22-0990-4fd4-8759-616e5423c20a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The storm is currently moving northeastward across the Gulf of Mexico and is expected to become a hurricane before making landfall in Louisiana on Wednesday. A storm surge warning is in effect for Sabine Pass, Texas, to the Mississippi-Alabama border, according to the [National Hurricane Center](https://substack.com/redirect/8aac1cc2-2cf4-432b-a0f3-d3001e51c888?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Storm surge warnings and watches for the Texas coast from High Island southward were discontinued as of Tuesday afternoon.

The storm comes about two months after [Hurricane Beryl](https://substack.com/redirect/c0b87fc5-bf10-43fb-aa0a-2ace81fc3eca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ripped through the Texas coast, knocking out power for millions of Texans and toppling trees and homes. Houston-area utility CenterPoint Energy [came under fire](https://substack.com/redirect/c187f7d8-2bd5-4356-820b-b4d4643fa22d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after that storm for failing to communicate clearly with customers and for not restoring power quickly enough. Some customers were without power for more than 10 days.

While minor power outages could occur with Francine, Abbott said power companies -- including CenterPoint -- would be expected to restore electricity within hours.

But Southeast Texas is expected to contend with occasional wind-whipped showers and rough surf Wednesday. So when will the risk of coastal flooding along the upper Texas Gulf Coast dwindle?

**Minimal rain threat for Houston**

Scattered downpours are most likely to occur in the Houston metro area along and east of Interstate 45. Similar to the showers that pushed through Houston on Tuesday, Wednesday's rain will likely be enough to result in wet roads and standing water -- but don't worry too much about street flooding. Wind gusts of 20 to 30 mph are possible at times as Francine bypasses Houston.

Along the coast, showers will continue, especially through the early afternoon. Downpours will be scattered at best and brief. Rainfall totals of an inch to 3 inches are expected, mainly from Galveston to Beaumont. [Coastal flood alerts](https://substack.com/redirect/310afcf7-6801-4edb-8f80-2b7090a1fc58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will continue as water piles up along the shore. Areas that dealt with rising water during Tropical Storm Alberto in June are likely to see it again Wednesday.

Beach closures and flood-prone coastal roads may be affected by the [1 to 3 feet storm surge](https://substack.com/redirect/b3d834dc-9823-46ed-a4d8-aeb0cb30d747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) forecast for the region. Wind gusts of 35 to 45 mph are possible at times, but this will not be enough to result in prolific power outages." [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/06e66e6c-cdf2-47ea-b35a-3274fc8e3d9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

**" Abbott says potential power outages from Tropical Storm Francine will be restored within hours,"** Texas Tribune's **Pooja Salhotra** -- "Tropical Storm Francine could bring life-threatening storm surge, dangerous winds and high water on Texas roadways along the Gulf Coast, Gov. **Greg Abbott** said Tuesday morning, urging Texans to heed advice from their local officials and remain vigilant because the storm could still change course.

Galveston County Judge **Mark Henry** issued a [voluntary evacuation order](https://substack.com/redirect/8490e371-2048-4dc2-a6f6-6dfe1283c440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the Bolivar Peninsula through Wednesday evening because flooding and high tides could hamper travel to and from the peninsula, leaving vulnerable people at-risk.

The storm is currently moving northeastward across the Gulf of Mexico and is expected to become a hurricane before making landfall in Louisiana on Wednesday. A storm surge warning is in effect for Sabine Pass, Texas, to the Mississippi-Alabama border, according to the [National Hurricane Center](https://substack.com/redirect/d42aba91-1315-4397-b9ce-eeffac8d8754?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Storm surge warnings and watches for the Texas coast from High Island southward were discontinued as of Tuesday afternoon.

The storm comes about two months after [Hurricane Beryl](https://substack.com/redirect/783663f2-f39b-45b5-bcb4-d3ba7f66541a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ripped through the Texas coast, knocking out power for millions of Texans and toppling trees and homes. Houston-area utility CenterPoint Energy [came under fire](https://substack.com/redirect/401cd6ec-be28-40a6-aea2-69ee5914eff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after that storm for failing to communicate clearly with customers and for not restoring power quickly enough. Some customers were without power for more than 10 days.

While minor power outages could occur with Francine, Abbott said power companies -- including CenterPoint -- would be expected to restore electricity within hours.

Houston-area utility CenterPoint Energy after that storm for failing to communicate clearly with customers and for not restoring power quickly enough. **ICYMI: Terra Lawson-Remer, The Absentee Supervisor**

Dear Friend,
Check out this article from San Diego News Desk exposing TerraLawson-Remer’s alarming record of missing nearly 74% of her committee and subcommittee votes. She’s also been a no-show at crucial homeless task force meetings, all while homelessness skyrockets. Kevin Faulconer, on the other hand, showed up to work every day and delivered results as mayor, reducing homelessness, created new housing opportunities and made San Diego the safest city in the country. Let’s hold Lawson-Remer accountable.
Read the full article here: [San Diego News Desk](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=4b5c5df4a4&e=784f78234b)

| _**Terra Lawson-Remer: The Absentee Supervisor**_ _**by San Diego News Desk**_
_As a Supervisor for District 3 of San Diego County, Terra Lawson-Remer earns $278,000 per year. As of September 2024, the median salary in San Diego County is $73,080. Lawson-Remer earns 3.8 times the salary of her citizens. Yet, she has the worst attendance record of any San Diego County politician._
_San Diegans grapple every day with the crushing rise in grocery, housing and energy prices. Workers must work harder and longer than ever before just to make ends meet. California’s ever increasing tax rates eat into every citizen’s take-home pay, food budgets, and transportation costs. Unfortunately, some politicians, like Terra Lawson-Remer, disrespect the sacrifice of San Diego’s working class by using their taxpayer funded salary to live luxuriously while not showing up for work._
_Terra Lawson-Remer exemplifies that sort of privileged politician. According to San Diego Signal News, Lawson-Remer missed a staggering 74% of her committee and subcommittee votes since she was elected. Shockingly, Terra Lawson-Remer failed to show up for any of the required meetings of the San Diego Regional Task Force on Homelessness where she was appointed as Vice Chair. On May 22, 2024, that task force reported 10,605 homeless residents sleeping in shelters or outdoors, marking a 3% year-over-year spike in San Diego County’s homeless population._
_San Diego County faces cascading crises like homelessness, water pollution and dramatically increased costs of living. Judging by Terra Lawson-Remer’s abysmal attendance record, she doesn’t care about helping San Diegans. Voters trusted her to solve the county’s problems but, like many career politicians, Terra Lawson-Remer put her own power and wealth first._
_Any self-respecting San Diegan that makes a public salary of $278,000 per year should be rightfully expected to show up for work more than half the time. Instead, Lawson-Remer spent her time and money buying two houses worth at least $1.4 million in 2021. As of June 2024, she’s missed every 2023/24 meeting of the SANDAG Regional Planning Committee, San Diego Air Pollution Control District Board, San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station Fuel Removal Committee and the North San Diego County Transit Development Board._
_San Diegans deserve better than a part-time supervisor._
_In stark contrast, as mayor, Kevin Faulconer got the job done. Homelessness decreased during Faulconer’s tenure. He worked with respected local groups like Father Joe’s Village to build community stakeholders. Faulconer will take his problem-solving skills and common-sense solutions to the San Diego County Board of Supervisors. San Diegans know Mayor Faulconer shows up to work and keeps his promises. Based on his accomplishments, Kevin Faulconer should lead District 3 as the next Supervisor of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors._

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: here’s how the debate went . . .
body:
Dear Pennsylvania,

I knew something was wrong when my phone started blowing up late Thursday afternoon with one frantic call and text after another from Students for Life Action’s best canvassers.

These are the young men and women who are the backbone of our election year programs, Pennsylvania.

They’re the people who care so much about saving the lives of preborn babies that they’ll spend DAYS walking on blistered feet to knock on doors in the key Battleground States and Referendum States like Florida that Students for Life Action is targeting.

They were contacting me to tell me they’ve HAD IT!

Before I talked them off that cliff and explained why sitting out this election is not possible for pro-lifers because there are so many critical races, they were all devasted to hear President Trump’s comments to NBC about how he supports abortions at six weeks, when babies have a beating heart.

The full video NBC posted on X is
here
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/o7ACgIutGKUJKPWLREL6fQ~~/AAVkMwA~~~
. . . if you’d like to see it.

Initial news reports following this interview stated that President Trump “seemed” to be saying he would be voting FOR Florida’s pro-abortion referendum, Amendment 4, as he told NBC:

“I think six weeks is too short. There has to be more time. I’ve told them that I want more weeks. I’m going to be voting that we leave more than six weeks [for legal abortion].”

But since then, Donald Trump’s campaign has backtracked and personally assured us that he hasn’t officially stated how he’ll vote on Florida’s Amendment 4.

To re-cap, if passed, Florida’s Amendment 4 would:

• Overturn the Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law, which Students for Life Action fought tooth and nail to ensure it passed & currently prohibits abortions after six weeks of a pregnancy. It’s the only thing stopping Florida from becoming the abortion sanctuary of the South;

• Legalizes abortion through six months of a pregnancy, at least;

• Allows for “health” abortions – which would allow sadness (mental health) about being pregnant as a reason to obtain a legal abortion at any stage. This would effectively mean Florida would be no different than states that allow abortion up until birth;

• Allows abortionists to commit abortions on minors WITHOUT parental “approval” on the killing.

This is bad as a lot of damage has been done.

And I’m worried that damage won’t be undone without your IMMEDIATE action to convince President Trump to fix it.

That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your petition to President Trump urging him to join Governor Ron DeSantis in PUBLICLY committing to voting no on “Amendment 4” – and encourage Americans to vote NO on all other pro-abortion ballot referendumsacross the country
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/-emFBzu-RoSjKzTNz7HOog~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRoxJghP4Q_-JminMyWFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~
.

The truth is, I understand why our door-knockers were so angry.

First, Donald Trump is just horribly wrong.

If we are to remain free at all as Americans, our God-given RIGHT to life must be protected from conception to natural death. Human life is just as valuable at six weeks after conception as it is at President Trump’s age of 78.

Second, our student canvassers are busting their behinds in places like Florida to save preborn lives.

And polls show we have a chance to win too as Governor Ron DeSantis has chosen to stand up to the Abortion Lobby and fight back.

So, if President Trump doesn’t change his position – and Amendment 4 passes in Florida – he will have blood on his hands.

Sadly, every statement President Trump makes on abortion lately seems to side with our enemies.

Just last week, Donald Trump posted on Truth Social:

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/DyimGzBlflBIS5KA-ylO-Q~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRoxJghP4Q_-JminMyWFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~

And his Vice Presidential nominee, J.D. Vance, told NBC’s Meet the Press – when asked whether or not President Trump would sign any sort of national abortion prevention law – stated:

“I mean, if you’re not supporting it, as the President of the United States, you fundamentally have to veto it.”

Pennsylvania, I’m not sure who is giving President Trump all this bad advice, but if you want to throw an election, this is how you’d do it.

You’d deflate your base and refuse to give any of your supporters a reason to vote for you.

And this can’t happen.

Because Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are abortion extremists.

Just look at what they did at the Democratic National Convention last week.

This isn’t my grandfather’s Democratic Party anymore. “Safe, legal, and rare” has been thrown out with the babies and bathwater and now it’s “Abortion whenever, for any reason, and taxpayer funded.”

The only reason President Trump is giving pro-lifers to vote for him is that he’s not Kamala Harris (which admittedly is a good reason).

BUT . . . that doesn’t come with much excitement.

And GOP candidates who don’t excite people – like John McCain and Mitt Romney – lose.

That’s why, when our canvassers told me they were “done” this election year, I told them to:

- Be patient and see if the Trump campaign fixes this – because Donald Trump does “shoot from the lip” quite a bit;

- Worse-case scenario, this new version of Trump can campaign for himself, and we’ll focus on races where we have candidates who actually understand abortion is wrong and must be abolished.

I hope that doesn’t happen – especially how high the stakes are in 2024.

The good news is, regardless of what President Trump’s advisors are telling him, it’s people like you are actually his best advisors.

And he has listened to grassroots Americans in the past.

That’s why it’s up to pro-lifers like you and me to make sure make sure Donald Trump publicly commits to joining Governor DeSantis in opposing Amendment 4!

If you agree,
please sign your petition to President Trump urging him to join Governor Ron DeSantis in PUBLICLY committing to voting NO on “Amendment 4” – and tell voters to do the same on all other pro-abortion ballot referendums across the country
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/XYxektLaaUd1gF8_o8eozg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRoxJghP4Q_-JminMyWFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~
.

Pennsylvania, the Pro-Life Movement NEEDS President Trump to stop running scared from the Abortion Lobby.

We need him actually mean it when he says, “Fight, fight, fight!”

With so much at stake, it’s time for us to make our voices heard once again.

So, please sign your petition
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9UihVM2lbllRKMlnU3DKhA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRoxJghP4Q_-JminMyWFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~
.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – Right now we have referendum battles going on in states across the country and Students for Life Action is fighting to win them!

But we can’t without your immediate support.

Will you please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to Students for Life Action to help us continue our battle against late-term abortion referendums
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/cbyBOSdiz_7dFenBGZeqUg~~/AAVkMwA~~~
?

Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Students for Life of America is powered by the Pro-Life Generation
1000 Winchester St., Suite 301
Fredericksburg, VA 22401
Office: 540.834.4600

Students for Life of America is a Section 501(c)(3) charity under the Internal Revenue Code. As such, your gift is tax-deductible to the fullest extent of the law. When the amount needed for the specific need(s) referenced in this communication is raised, any contributions that exceed the amount needed will be used in the area of greatest need as determined by Students for Life of America, even if that need is unrelated to the specific request in this communication.

subject: “Dear Americans, if you are killed by the Israeli government, our country won’t care.”

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In the last week, an American citizen was shot and killed by Israeli
military forces in the West Bank, and multiple 2,000-lb bombs were dropped
on tents of displaced people in Gaza, killing at least 40 Palestinians and
injuring 60 more.

But none of that was acknowledged during last night’s presidential debate.

Once again, we heard empty words about this current administration
“working around the clock” to achieve a ceasefire and release of hostages,
with no action to back it up. In the same 24 hours, President Biden
suggested that the death of 26-year-old American activist Ayşenur Ezgi
Eygi — who was shot in the head by an Israeli sniper — was likely an
accident.

The fact is the United States has continued to enable Netanyahu with
weapons and bombs to carry out massacres against innocent people, even
when American citizens are murdered in the process. The White House has
done nothing to hold the right-wing Israeli government accountable for its
war crimes against Palestinians and Americans alike.

Justice Democrats Rep. Rashida Tlaib, the only Palestinian-American in
Congress, was right when she said:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240911_justice_for_aysenur_eygi/?source=em20240911-35984&t=1002&akid=35984%2E1203867%2E6UCXLr ]Tweet from Rashida Tlaib: Dear Americans, If you are killed by the
Israeli government, our country won’t care. No one will be held
accountable. It doesn’t matter who you are, Israel can kill Americans and
get away with it.

That has to change, Peter,
and the only way it will is if we keep up
the pressure on our leaders to listen to the people they represent and do
what they were elected to.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240911_justice_for_aysenur_eygi/?source=em20240911-35984&t=1003&akid=35984%2E1203867%2E6UCXLr ]It starts with an immediate, independent investigation into Ayşenur’s
murder by the Israeli military. Add your name to demand the Biden
administration start holding Netanyahu accountable and stop the senseless
murder of more innocent people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240911_justice_for_aysenur_eygi/?source=em20240911-35984&t=1004&akid=35984%2E1203867%2E6UCXLr ]Add Your Name

We demand justice for Ayşenur, for the tens of thousands of innocent lives
taken, for the hostages and their families, and for the millions of
displaced and starving Palestinians waiting for the world to stop the
genocide against them.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

# Sharon Clahchischilliage Tells Her Story of 9/11/2001
---
|
---
|

## That Morning.

The morning of 9/11 I was driving to work as the Executive Director for the NCUIH - National Council for Urban Indian Health. Traffic was backed up more than usual that day and that is when I noticed 4 fighter jets flying in formation. I then saw another set of fighter jets.

They were flying extremely low and that moment I knew something was wrong.
I made the decision to turn around and go home and that is when I found out that the WTC Towers and Pentagon had been attacked. I of course called all my staff and ordered them to go home and to stay home.
I later visited the Pentagon and I saw first hand the scope and magnitude of the damage. I was overwhelmed with anger and sadness. At that moment I chose to use it as resolve to do my part to come together and unify with our fellow Americans.
---
|
## In the Aftermath

That week there were was an IHS Health conference for tribes. The attacks and subsequent flight restrictions left many people stranded from as far away as Alaska.
As the Executive Director of the Navajo Nation office I made sure that our office utilized every resource to help those who were stranded to make contact love ones and let them know they were safe.
From there we came together as a community and as Americans to quickly plan logistics and find rental vans to get people home safely. Together we worked out ride shares that went across the country to drop people off back to their homes and with their families.
---
|
## What I Learned

I have always been called to be a servant-leader for my communities. As a leader one never knows what one will do in the face of tragedy and adversity. I feel blessed and grateful that God kept us safe that day and allowed everyone to come together resiliently.
This is why I am asking for your vote and your support as your next U.S. Congresswoman to represent New Mexico in Washington, DC. Vote for Sharon Clahchischilliage.

As a leader one never knows what one will do in the face of tragedy and adversity. I feel blessed and grateful that God kept us safe that day and allowed everyone to come together resiliently. This is why I am asking for your vote and your support as your next U.S. Congresswoman to represent New Mexico in Washington, DC. Vote for Sharon Clahchischilliage. name: Tara, Cat Lady on Team Kaine
subject: Me and Taylor Swift, two peas in a pod
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi! I’m Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
You might have seen the news that last night, notable cat lady Taylor Swift endorsed Kamala Harris and Tim Walz for the White House
Taylor and I actually have a lot in common. I, too, am a proud cat lady who supports Kamala and Tim (and the other Tim — Kaine, that is!)
This is me with my cats, Ada (named after computer science pioneer Ada Lovelace) and Nikola (named after inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla), and Taylor with one of her three cats, Benjamin Button.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Contrary to what JD Vance thinks, neither Taylor Swift nor I are actually miserable! Nor do we think we deserve less of a voice in our democracy than any other American — unlike Vance.
(Seriously — JD Vance has said in multiple recently resurfaced interviews that he thinks the Democratic Party is being run by “miserable childless cat ladies” and that people without kids have less of a stake in our country and should have less of a voice. Oh, and he thinks we should pay more taxes. Like, what?)
At first glance, those comments are so absurd that they’re funny.
But the thing is, he’s not joking.
And when someone who’s in the running to be our nation’s next Vice President says stuff like this, we have to listen to what he’s really saying. Here’s my best attempt at a translation:
Women have to be married and have kids to be happy and functioning members of our society. We should define who gets to vote based on their parental status. Cats are bad (??!!).
Meanwhile, he’s also trying to take control of how people become parents in the first place, with positions that threaten to limit both IVF and birth control, not to mention other reproductive care.
If you’ve read this far and you agree that we can’t let JD Vance anywhere near the Vice Presidency, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign here in Virginia. We’re working around the clock to make sure VA’s 13 electoral votes go to Kamala Harris, not the Trump-Vance ticket — and that we can re-elect Tim Kaine to the U.S. Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, everyone is entitled to their own views. You don’t like cats? Fine! But what you don’t get to do — especially when you’re in the running to lead this country! — is tell the American people that their personal reproductive choices make them less a part of our democracy. That’s just BS.
I’m all in to stop JD Vance from becoming our next Vice President, and I’m so proud that our team here in Virginia is building a massive voter outreach program to mobilize Democrats in every corner of the Commonwealth.
When we vote, we win — so if you can, please chip in to help us reach and turn out more voters! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much.
-Tara
Virginia Finance Director, Team Kaine
P.S. Here’s another cat pic, just for good measure...

1490-5A Quarterpath Road #272
Williamsburg, VA 23185

body:
This is a historic moment — but the work’s not over.
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240911-2?refcode=em20240911-2-1188&amount=5&refcode2=1188_21716_nVVFR9&akid=1188%2E21716%2EnVVFR9)
Thank you!
**I’m honored to earn the Democratic nomination to represent Delaware in Congress.**
There is quite literally no path to victory that does not include you — no matter how you supported me thus far, you own a piece of this win.
And in November, you’ll own that historic victory as well.
We will shatter the lavender glass ceiling in Congress, and I will be the first out trans member of Congress in its 235-year history. **It is a monumental step forward, but the work is far from over.**
[**There are less than 8 weeks left in this election, and every single dollar makes a difference in the fight ahead: Be part of this historic moment with a founding donation of $5 or more right now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240911-2?refcode=em20240911-2-1188&amount=5&refcode2=1188_21716_nVVFR9&akid=1188%2E21716%2EnVVFR9)
I’m so hopeful for the future right now, but I can’t ignore the present: This will make me even more of a target for far-right extremists.
Marjorie Taylor Greene has already called this campaign a “complete evil” that would “curse” the nation — but we turned those hurtful words into action and built a powerful, united, and joyful coalition.
While MAGA extremists will always be particularly weird when it comes to Americans like me, their inhumanity stands in direct contrast with my literal humanity and the trans community nationwide. And right now, there isn’t a single transgender representative in Congress to stand up to them. **YOU can change that.**
We can let their unhinged behavior contrast with my approach to the job — which is to roll up my sleeves, dive into the details, bring people together, and work to make historic progress on the issues we all care about: affordable health care and housing, abortion access, gun reform, and more.
[**That’s the work ahead, and that’s what I’m hoping you’ll invest in right now — we’re building the foundation to win on Election Day, and I want us to own this victory, together. Donate $5 or more to become a Founding Donor to my general election campaign right now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240911-2?refcode=em20240911-2-1188&amount=5&refcode2=1188_21716_nVVFR9&akid=1188%2E21716%2EnVVFR9)

Thank you,
Sarah

---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

First, let me begin, for those of us who were alive, September 11th is a day we will never forget in America’s history. We all know where we were when we heard the horrific news.

My husband and I moved to Phoenix at the end of August 2001. We relocated to Arizona for his job. Prior to moving to Arizona, his office was less than a 5-minute walk to the White House. As you may recall, after 9-11 there were heavy security perimeters erected by what evolved into the Department of Homeland Security in and around Washington, DC. His employer and his co-workers were limited on physically working in their office after 9-11.

Prior to meeting my husband, in 1997, for about 6 months I worked at a New York City public high school across from Trinity Church. In the aftermath of 9-11, this magnet school was converted into a morgue while human remains were recovered and identified, and grieving families received some closure.

We knew individuals who lost loved ones on 9-11. And a friend of my husband’s perished that day when her plane crashed into the Pentagon.

I often think of how divided our country was after the 2000 presidential election, but we came together in the aftermath of 9-11.

In 2001, I remember attending quite a few Diamondbacks baseball games leading up to their World Series win and how patriotic the fans stood to salute our military, law enforcement, first responders, and our flag.

Years ago, on one of our trips back to New York City with our kids, I remember walking over to that high school where I had once worked and then, making our way over to where the twin towers once stood because it was only a block away.

It was hard to hold back tears seeing the massive hole in the ground.

Even 23 years later, the resolve of America, its values and resilience to prevail against our enemies is still strong. When we pull together or take the time to listen, our friends and neighbors are often in agreement, but details certainly matter to achieve that end goal.

Earlier this morning I met with two groups of civic-oriented students attending Grand Canyon University. It is always fun to talk a little bit about life at the Arizona Capitol and my journey into public service. Each day I am reminded I heeded this call for such a time is this.

Whether it’s enlightening young minds, talking with our neighbors, or meeting a long-time friend, people of all ages are worried about our future. They want to feel safe, again in this land of opportunity that our forefathers fought so hard.

On this day, please take a moment and remember how important it is for Americans to be united. Our foreign opponents are working to worsen polarization.

#NeverForget

Take care,
Shawnna

name: Jill Stein
subject: Debate Highlight Reel: Two candidates wholly unfit to lead
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=1)
---
Peter,

What a spectacle we witnessed last night.

In this much-hyped meeting of the two corporate party candidates, we were promised two very different visions for our country as they continue to court your vote. But that’s not what we got.

Both Harris and Trump boasted about embracing war criminals and guaranteeing the dominance of American capital at the expense of all else.

Both of them promised to support fracking and bragged about their results in expanding fossil fuel extraction.

Both of them promised to continue building our military and stoked military tensions with Iran, China, and Russia.

But indeed, there were _some_ differences between Harris and Trump.

**Harris bragged about supporting the border militarization bill** that Trump killed.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=2)
---
She also doubled down on **bragging about being endorsed by some of the worst Republicans and unrepentant war criminals in living memory** :
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=3)
---
And repeated her promise both to “always give Israel the right to defend itself” and to maintain the U.S. military as “the most lethal fighting force in the world.”****
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=4)
---
As for Donald Trump...

He predictably leaned on racist tropes and violent rhetoric that demonizes and dehumanizes our immigrant neighbors, spreads vicious lies about women exercising control over our own bodies, and fans the flames of hatred against our 2SLGBTQIA+ family.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=5)
---
Trump’s cynical rhetoric on abortion was perhaps the most revolting to me.

His fake concern over “abortions after birth” (a far-right fever-dream) rings particularly hollow as he and every member of the Republican party supports Israel’s genocide – which is literally executing babies every single day in Gaza.

Still, when you strip past the theatrics, the simple fact is there is very little policy daylight between these two candidates.

Both candidates agree on giving Israel unilateral authority over our foreign policy decisions in the Middle East.

Both agree on unlimited militarization of our border (they only quibble over who gets the credit).

Both agree that private interests like the profit of fossil fuel companies outweigh the collective interest of the survival of our species and our planet.

And they both gleefully embrace the support of war criminals, genociders, “transnational” thugs, and despots.

Donald Trump has and will continue to advance the interests of Christian Nationalist fundamentalists and white supremacists in his pursuit of unrestrained power.

Kamala Harris chooses the softer approach to fascism of capitulating to endless war and corporate rule in exchange for half a billion in campaign contributions.

**The end result is the same. Working people are squeezed back into the meat grinder of our exploitation economy, the American empire remains unchecked, and our planet is burned to ash as our core democratic freedoms – like the rights to protest, boycott, and petition our government for grievance – are crushed.
**
There is one single, solitary fair point that Donald Trump raised. **For all the things Harris has promised to do...why isn’t she doing it now?**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=debate_response_sept&n=6)
---
Harris again repeated last night that she and the president are “working tirelessly” for a ceasefire agreement in Gaza. But there are simple measures the administration could take today – indeed, could have taken months ago – that would have saved COUNTLESS innocent lives.

**How many more Palestinians have to die while we wait for Kamala Harris to take the reins? Why can’t this be done today?

** If we want to chart a new path as a nation and as humankind, we did not see that path articulated on last night’s debate stage.

body:

---
The main reason Democrats pushed Joe Biden out of the race for president was not to win the White House. _**It was actually done to save vulnerable Democrats running down the ballot.**_ The thinking was that even if Kamala Harris or another replacement could not defeat Donald Trump, they could at least make it close enough to save Democrats like **Jon Tester** in Montana, **Sherrod Brown** in Ohio, **Tammy Baldwin** in Wisconsin, and **Jacky Rosen** in Nevada. This campaign has had a clear and consistent message, and it’s resonating: the failures of the Biden-Wild team have left working families, seniors, and young people behind. Rising costs, open borders, and a failed foreign policy are putting the American dream out of reach.
I know that we can do better, and that’s why I’m running. We can secure our border, fight inflation, end taxes on social security, and stop the failed policies coming out of Washington D.C. I hope to earn your support.

Ryan Mackenzie
